raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in genealogical reasoning by incorrectly identifying the paternal grandfather as "King Chulalongkorn (Rama V)". The evidence gathered in Step 2 explicitly stated that Busba's father, Nakkhatra Mangala Kitiyakara, was the son of "Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana" (the twelfth son of King Chulalongkorn). The Planner failed to distinguish between the grandfather (the father of the father) and the great-grandfather (the father of the grandfather). Instead of concluding that the paternal grandfather is Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana, the Planner erroneously jumped to the next generation up the lineage tree, naming King Chulalongkorn as the grandfather. This contradicts the established fact that Voralaksana is the father of Nakkhatra Mangala.
